In the past, the Mohist Gate had an Elder who took in five disciples. As all five specialized in the study of intricate mechanisms and crafted many wondrous devices, they were collectively known as the "Five Marvels" by other disciples in the sect. The youngest among them was a survivor of the wars outside the mountains who happened to flee into the Hidden Peaks. Consumed by hatred, he used his knowledge of intricate mechanisms to create various poisonous insects, intending to seek revenge once his training was complete. The Elder, seeing the darkness in his heart, never taught him the full extent of the art. Before the four senior disciples departed for their travels, they crafted poisonous insect mechanisms to lure and eliminate the Poisonous Beings in the mountains with strange sounds—just to prove to their master that such devices could also serve a beneficial purpose. In the process of jointly creating the Five Poisons, they secretly passed on the final secrets of intricate mechanisms to their junior.
The Ironheart Centipede was one of the Five Poisonous Insects, crafted by the third senior disciple, Ding Jiexiang. "Wish for an iron heart, unshaken by slander. In this life, free from resentment, pure as moonlight."
